## 6. Special Allowance for Child Care for women with Disabilities  
1. Women with disabilities shall be paid ~ 3,000 per month as Special Allowance for Child Care. The allowance· shall be payable from the time of
2. the child's birth till the child is two years old.  
- Order No. 26 of Appendix-B; FR &. SR Part-I.  
2. It shall be· payable for a maximum of two children.
3. The above limit would be automatically raised by 25% every time
